definitions.explanation: A light, fast bicycle with thin tyres and usually drop handlebars, made for riding on paved roads; used for road racing and long-distance cycling as a hobby.

examples.japanese: ロードバイク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ロードバイク⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: At weekends I ride my road bike.

examples.japanese: ロードバイク⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{坂道|さかみち}→坂道：08166_sakamichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|のぼ}れる→上る：21460_noboru⟧。
examples.english: A road bike is light, so you can climb even slopes easily.

notes:
Despite ⟦バイク→バイク：05081_baiku⟧, this is a bicycle, not a motorbike: on its own, ⟦バイク→バイク：05081_baiku⟧ means a motorcycle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ロードバイク⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride a road bike
- ロードバイク⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to commute by road bike
